panels.title: Agentix build
panels.description: A missing series means application data is unavailable; it does not identify a host or collector failure.

panels.title: agentix CPU utilization
panels.description: 100% means one fully used CPU core; multithreaded usage can exceed 100%. Only this service process, excluding child agents.

panels.title: agentix virtual memory
panels.description: Virtual address space, not physical RAM consumption.

panels.title: taskix CPU utilization
panels.description: 100% means one fully used CPU core; multithreaded usage can exceed 100%. Only this service process, excluding child agents.

panels.title: taskix virtual memory
panels.description: Virtual address space, not physical RAM consumption.

panels.title: First output p95
panels.description: Measured once per observed turn. No per-fragment histogram updates.

panels.title: First output p99
panels.description: Measured once per observed turn. No per-fragment histogram updates.

panels.title: Nonterminal entity age
panels.description: Time since last entity update, not execution latency. Human waiting is not an incident by itself.

panels.title: Observed transitions / second
panels.description: Starts at exporter baseline; persisted history is never replayed as new activity.

panels.title: Agent input tokens / second
panels.description: Observed native usage by agent source. Reconnect snapshots establish a baseline; missing counts stay missing. Cached means cache-read tokens; input/output semantics follow each host provider.

panels.title: Agent output tokens / second
panels.description: Observed native usage by agent source. Reconnect snapshots establish a baseline; missing counts stay missing. Cached means cache-read tokens; input/output semantics follow each host provider.

panels.title: Agent cached tokens / second
panels.description: Observed native usage by agent source. Reconnect snapshots establish a baseline; missing counts stay missing. Cached means cache-read tokens; input/output semantics follow each host provider.

panels.title: Agent observed tokens in selected range
panels.description: Partial observed usage, not billing. Codex cached input is a subset of Codex input. Missing usage stays missing. Never sum this with existing OTLP usage.

panels.title: Memory observed tokens in selected range
Adoption ratio
panels.description: Adoption is not accuracy. Only requests persisted after the exporter baseline are counted.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance,kind) (rate(taskix_jev_decisions_total{instance=~"$instance",outcome="accepted"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (instance,kind) (rate(taskix_jev_decisions_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (instance,kind) (rate(taskix_jev_decisions_total{instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mean decision latency
panels.description: Mean of persisted request durations observed since the exporter baseline.

panels.title: Decision latency p95
panels.description: Estimated from fixed buckets for requests observed since the exporter baseline. Sparse traffic and wide buckets reduce tail precision.

panels.title: Decision latency p99
panels.description: Estimated from fixed buckets for requests observed since the exporter baseline. Sparse traffic and wide buckets reduce tail precision.

panels.title: Mean request confidence
panels.description: Mean of available per-request answer confidence, not calibrated accuracy.

panels.title: Human review counts
panels.description: Recomputed so late human reviews appear. Includes historical reviewed requests.

panels.title: Reviewed accuracy
panels.description: Only the reviewed subset. No reviews means no data.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance,kind) (taskix_jev_reviewed{instance=~"$instance",result="correct"}) or (0 * sum by (instance,kind) (taskix_jev_reviewed{instance=~"$instance",result=~"correct|incorrect"}))) / sum by (instance,kind) (taskix_jev_reviewed{instance=~"$instance",result=~"correct|incorrect"})
